notes.subject: bel isi
notes.rationale: אפים i tok 'nus/narapela bilong nus' — Hibru i yusim nus bilong tok.bel; Tok Pisin i tok 'bel'.

notes.subject: klostu long
notes.rationale: יפתה i tok 'opim' o 'mekim wanpela i luksave' — 'klostu long' i tok pasin bilong winim bel bilong man.

notes.subject: ⟨wanpela⟩
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat wanpela samting bilong holim 'bun' — Tok Pisin i nidim ⟨wanpela⟩.

notes.subject: רכה...גרם
notes.rationale: Tongo 'malum' i brukim 'bun' — pilai bilong tok: samting soft i winim samting hat.

translation: Long pasin bilong hodim bel isi, yu ken klostu long man bilong skelim; na tongo isi i ken brukim ⟨wanpela⟩ bun.
